title: CodeCanary launches on Product Hunt
summary: We launched AI for session replays on Product Hunt today, highlighting bug fixes and conversion rate optimization
body_markdown:
Today, we[shared Code Canary with the Product Hunt community](https://www.producthunt.com/products/codecanary) :


> CodeCanary watches your session replays and conversion funnels to look for: 1. bugs, 2. UX friction, and 3. conversion optimization ideas. Once it finds an opportunity, it creates a pull request in the style of your existing pull requests.


Give us an upvote on the[Product Hunt website](https://www.producthunt.com/products/codecanary/launches/codecanary) , chat on the[forum](https://www.producthunt.com/p/codecanary) and thanks for the support!
